findings.doc_quote: which re-runs on app reload (triggered by hassette reload , or by config changes when automatic reloads are on)
findings.code_evidence: src/hassette/cli/__init__.py:74 `apps_app = App(name="app", ...)` and :114 `apps_app.command(cmd_app_reload, name="reload")`. There is no top-level `reload` command.
findings.explanation: The reload command is a subcommand of `app`, so it is invoked as `hassette app reload <key>`. A bare `hassette reload` does not exist.
findings.suggested_fix: triggered by `hassette app reload <key>`, or by config changes when automatic reloads are on

summary: The page is almost entirely accurate. I checked the signatures and defaults of run_in, run_once, run_every, run_minutely, run_hourly, run_daily, run_cron, schedule, register and add_job against scheduler.py and triggers.py. I also checked the ValueError conditions, the if_exists semantics, the fields compared by Job.matches, the `job_timeout_seconds` config and the whole-second rounding. The only error is the nonexistent `hassette reload` CLI command on line 156.
